description: Unicode characters: Greek letters, math symbols, ±, etc.
known_limitations: PyMuPDF default Helvetica font cannot render Greek letters or math symbols; they appear as '·'
Fixture generation limitation: insert_text with default font loses ε, θ, Σ, etc.
Normalized text may alter some Unicode (e.g., minus/dash normalization)
Greek letter aliases (epsilon, theta, etc.) not generated in V1
± and ASCII characters ARE preserved correctly
